svg.title: Cancelling gravity with the right, a wrong and no coefficient
svg.desc: With the true gravity coefficient the arm reaches 0.0915 radians after 1 second and settles at 0.1 radians without overshoot, held by minus 0.399 newton metres, exactly gravity's torque. With 3.5 newton metres it rests at 0.1032 radians, within the requirements; without compensation it rests at 0.1332 radians, above the 0.12-radian peak limit.
svg.text: Cancelling gravity with the right, a wrong and no coefficient
Control Studio recordings of this project · arm commanded from upright to 0.1 rad with Ĝ = 0, 3.5 and 4 N·m · numbers answer the predictions
Ĝ = 4: 0.0915 rad after 1 s, no overshoot
Ĝ = 0 rests at 0.1332 rad, Ĝ = 3.5 at 0.1032 rad
Ĝ = 3.5 and 4 within 0.01 rad from 4 s: both pass
